title: Pistis Incident
description: The incident JSON shape Pistis consumes. Producers (NEAT) MUST emit conforming JSON; consumers MAY accept additional unrecognised fields. This schema is the authoritative contract — keep it in sync with NormalizedIncident in src/incident/schema.ts.

incidentId.description: Stable identifier. NEAT can use either `id` or `incidentId`; Pistis normalises to `incidentId`.

id.description: Alias for incidentId; either may be present.

issueType.description: Free-form category. Pistis classifies internally; this is just the producer's view. Common values: runtime_exception, db_schema_or_query, policy_violation, deployment_regression.

severity.description: One of info|low|medium|high|critical. Other strings (warn, error, sev1, p0, p1, fatal) are accepted and coerced.

primaryNodeId.description: NEAT node id of the affected service (e.g. service:order-api). Required.

message.description: Human-readable summary of the issue. Often the exception message or short title.

evidence.description: Optional list of evidence items (stack traces, snippets, log excerpts, etc.). May also be a single object; Pistis normalises to array.

candidateFiles.description: Files Pistis should consider editing (a hint, not a hard scope — the contract builder narrows this further).

project.description: NEAT project id for project-scoped routing. Optional.
